answer: One workable design: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because shale only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, whisper is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any ledge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
